comment: The size of the golden set, as a number somebody has to change on purpose.
`prefixes` is the full-tier count per variant prefix, measured from base/develop. A build is
judged per prefix rather than on the total, because a pr-tier build renders two of the eleven and
comparing its two prefixes against the full total would pass anything.
`captureCap` is the per-spec ceiling. `capExceptions` lists the specs already over it with the
ticket that will bring them down; an exception without a ticket is refused, so the list cannot
Growing any number needs `[visual budget: N - reason]` in the pull-request description, where N is
the new total. Shrinking one is free, and expected: a trimming pull request lowers the file in the
same change that deletes the records.
